documents.title: Annual report extract
documents.text:
Annual report extract: Pennant Logistics (fictional, authored test material).
Throughout the documents of this review, the Borrower means Pennant Logistics. Pennant Logistics had gross debt of $377.5m in FY2025 (reported basis). For Saltmarsh, recurring revenue share in FY2024 was 95.9%. Operating costs at Pennant Logistics stood at $235.3m in FY2024 (reported basis). Pennant Logistics had cash on balance sheet of $13.4m in FY2025 (reported basis).

documents.title: Quarterly lender update
documents.text:
Quarterly lender update: Pennant Logistics (fictional, authored test material).
Pennant Logistics trades under the name Saltmarsh. the Borrower had gross debt of $451.4m in FY2025 (reported basis). For Pennant Logistics, recurring revenue share in FY2024 was 82.4%. Free cash flow at Pennant Logistics stood at $12.1m in FY2025 (reported basis). Pennant Logistics had receivables in arrears of 10.1% in FY2024. Throughout the documents of this review, "operating costs" means the same measure as operating expenses.

documents.title: Independent business review
documents.text:
Independent business review: Pennant Logistics (fictional, authored test material).
Pennant Logistics has a financial year ending on 31 March; FY2025 is the year ended 31 March 2025. Pennant Logistics had operating expenses of $206.9m in FY2024 (reported basis). For Pennant Logistics, cash on balance sheet in the twelve months to 31 Mar 2025 was $15.6m (reported basis). Free cash flow at Pennant Logistics stood at USD 10.7 million in FY2025 (reported basis). Pennant Logistics had receivables in arrears of 8.1% in FY2024.
